# MCP tools: External references

<!-- Generated by `sidekick.mcp.export_tool_reference` from `contracts/mcp-tools.generated.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

[MCP tool reference](index.md) | 2 model-visible tools. The tools of this area that only the MCP App rooms call are on the [app-only page](app-only.md).

## `link_external_reference_to_task`

Attach a mail, calendar event or document the user asked to link, found through their own connector, to a known Task (Task id, for example from get_work_agenda).

Access: write

Scopes: requires `tasks:read`, `tasks:write`.

Returns: `LinkResult` with `linked` (boolean), `reference` (ReferenceRecord), `relation_created` (boolean), `task_id` (uuid).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_ref` | string | yes | 1 to 200 characters |
| `external_id` | string | yes | 1 to 500 characters |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `kind` | string | yes | one of `mail`, `calendar_event`, `document` |
| `provider` | string | yes | one of `google_gmail`, `google_calendar`, `google_drive`, `other` |
| `task_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `title` | string | yes | 1 to 300 characters |
| `instance_ref` | string | no | 1 to 500 characters; may be null |
| `occurs_at` | date-time | no | ISO 8601 date and time; may be null |
| `url` | string | no | 1 to 2000 characters; may be null |

## `list_task_external_references`

Use this after a Task UUID is known to list the pointers (title, https link, provider) attached to it, bounded and paginated.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `tasks:read`.

Returns: `ReferencePage` with `items` (array of ReferenceRecord), `task_id` (uuid), `next_cursor` (string or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `task_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `cursor` | string | no | up to 2048 characters; may be null |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `25`; 1 to 50 |
